items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I played with that band until we quit and went with Art Bronson... That's when we got with Bronson, in Salina, Kansas, January 1928. Then I stayed with Bronson up to 1931.

ctx.x: Back to Bronson in 1930. And he was playing alto. Then he left us in 1930. He came to us in the Spring of 1930, and in the Fall of 1930, in Scott's Bluff, Nebraska, he left us.
